info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Education Enrollments Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollments Status API facilitates the retrieval of current enrollment statuses for educational programs. This endpoint allows users, such as administrators and educators, to access real-time information regarding student enrollments, including approval and processing statuses. It serves as a crucial resource for monitoring enrollment trends, enabling streamlined decision-making in educational institutions. The API supports various queries to improve visibility into enrollment efficiency and student engagement, aiding in operational planning and reporting.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current status of enrollments, providing insights into whether the enrollment is active, pending, or completed. Use this information to inform users about the progress of their enrollment.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving the status of enrollments. It should contain the necessary parameters to specify the enrollment whose status is being requested.

202.description: Request has been accepted for processing and is ongoing.

ListEducationEnrollmentsStatusRequest.description: Represents the status of enrollments in a string format.

ListEducationEnrollmentsStatusResponse_2.title: Enrollment Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the enrollment operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the enrollment request.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the enrollment operation.

state.description: Current state of the enrollment process.

processingTimeMs.description: The total time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the enrollment status.

ListEducationEnrollmentsStatusResponse_2.description: Response schema for the enrollment status operation, providing information about the status of the enrollment process.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the enrollment record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the enrollment record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the enrollment operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Schema containing audit information related to the enrollment operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This value provides insight into the performance of the operation when retrieving the enrollment status.
